title: Centre Stage

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Centre Stage offers a unique theatrical setting in the heart of downtown Greenville for performances, concerts, recitals, presentations, film screenings, meetings, and special events. Centre Stage is an active producing theatre, not an empty event venue. Rental events take place within our existing theatrical environment, which may include scenery, lighting equipment, and stage configurations associated with Centre Stage productions. Requests for specific stage layouts, backstage spaces, dressing rooms, greenroom access, or technical accommodations are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.
